description: Manual expense flow and strict multi-tenant isolation: client-facing manual expense creation (amount/description/date/category/EUR, deductible+btwRate inherited-but-editable, status PENDING), 'my expenses' list for the authenticated client, and the accountant review panel (approve/reject with mandatory note, status transitions, reviewedById/reviewedAt). Depends on FEAT-002 (auth, roles, categories). This FEAT does NOT include OCR/receipt upload (that's FEAT-004) — expenses here are created without a receipt image, receipt/ocrText/classificationConfidence stay null.
steps: Create POST /api/expenses/route.ts and GET /api/expenses/route.ts: POST requires session.user.role === 'CLIENT' and an ACTIVE ClientProfile; it creates an Expense with clientId = session.user.clientProfileId (never trust a client-supplied clientId), currency fixed to 'EUR', deductible/btwRate pre-filled from the selected Category but overridable by the request body, status PENDING. GET lists expenses: for a CLIENT, filtered to `where: { clientId: session.user.clientProfileId }` only — this is the real multi-tenant isolation enforcement, do it at the Prisma query level, not by filtering an unscoped result in memory. For an ACCOUNTANT, GET supports an optional ?clientId= filter but must verify `clientId`'s ClientProfile.accountantId === session.user.id before returning anything (403 otherwise) — an accountant must never see another accountant's clients' expenses.

Create GET/PATCH /api/expenses/[id]/route.ts: GET returns the expense only if (CLIENT and expense.clientId === session.user.clientProfileId) or (ACCOUNTANT and expense.client.accountantId === session.user.id), else 404 (not 403, to avoid leaking existence). PATCH is used by the client only while status === PENDING and not locked (e.g. to fix a typo) — reject edits once APPROVED/REJECTED or locked.

Create POST /api/expenses/[id]/review/route.ts: ACCOUNTANT-only (verified server-side), requires the expense's client to belong to this accountant (403 otherwise), body = { decision: 'APPROVED'|'REJECTED', note?: string }; REJECTED requires a non-empty note (400 otherwise per the task's 'note mandatory on reject' requirement); on success sets status, reviewNote, reviewedById = session.user.id, reviewedAt = now, and sets locked = true for APPROVED (and optionally for REJECTED, pick one and document the choice: locking REJECTED too prevents further client edits after a decision, which matches 'accountant always reviews manually' intent — lock both).

Create src/app/app/expenses/page.tsx (CLIENT 'my expenses' list, filtered server-side via the GET endpoint or a direct Prisma call in a Server Component using the same clientId-scoping rule) and src/app/app/expenses/new/page.tsx (manual creation form: amount, description, date, category select, deductible/btwRate pre-filled from category selection and editable, submit calls POST /api/expenses).

Create src/app/admin/clients/[clientId]/expenses/page.tsx (ACCOUNTANT per-client PENDING review list — this FEAT only needs the list + approve/reject actions; the receipt-image-beside-data visual polish with confidence flags is FEAT-004's job once receipts/classification exist, but the approve/reject UI and API wiring belongs here since it's needed for manually-created expenses too). Must verify clientId belongs to the current accountant before rendering (404 otherwise).

Run `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, and a short-lived start+curl smoke test: as an unauthenticated/wrong-tenant request, GET /api/expenses?clientId=<other-accountant-client> must return 403; a correctly-scoped GET must return 200 with only that tenant's rows.
acceptance_criteria: A client can create a manual expense via POST /api/expenses and it appears in their own GET /api/expenses with status PENDING
A client's GET /api/expenses never returns another client's rows, verified by creating two clients under the same accountant and asserting cross-client isolation via a script
An accountant's GET /api/expenses?clientId=X for a client NOT belonging to them returns 403, verified via a script with two accountants
POST .../review with decision=REJECTED and no note returns 400; with a note it succeeds and sets reviewedById/reviewedAt and status=REJECTED
Once an expense is APPROVED or REJECTED, further client PATCH attempts are rejected (locked)
`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build` all pass
verification: `npm run build` — succeeds, lists /app/expenses, /app/expenses/new, /admin/clients/[clientId]/expenses, /api/expenses, /api/expenses/[id]/review among routes

A one-off script (scripts/verify-isolation.ts, deleted or documented afterward) that seeds two accountants each with a client and an expense, then calls the GET/POST handlers' underlying logic directly via Prisma-scoped queries (or via fetch against a short-lived `npm run start` instance with real session cookies obtained through a programmatic sign-in) and asserts tenant isolation holds in both directions — prints PASS/FAIL
Short-lived `npm run start` + curl smoke test of at least one authenticated-with-cookie request path, then kill the server
findings: Route shapes (for FEAT-004): GET /api/expenses — CLIENT session returns their own expenses (where: { clientId: session.user.clientProfileId }), ACCOUNTANT session with no ?clientId returns all expenses across their own clients (where: { client: { accountantId: session.user.id } }), ACCOUNTANT with ?clientId=X first verifies prisma.clientProfile.findUnique({ where: { id: X } }).accountantId === session.user.id (403 otherwise) before querying where: { clientId: X } — isolation is always enforced in the Prisma WHERE clause, never by filtering an unscoped result in memory. POST /api/expenses — CLIENT-only (role==='CLIENT' && clientStatus==='ACTIVE'), body {amount, description, date, categoryId, deductible?, btwRate?}; clientId is always session.user.clientProfileId (never trusts a client-supplied clientId); categoryId is validated to belong to the client's own accountant (via ClientProfile.accountantId) before use; deductible/btwRate default to the Category's defaults but are overridable by the request body; currency is hardcoded 'EUR'; status always starts PENDING; returns 201 with the created expense (category included). GET /api/expenses/[id] — returns 404 (never 403) for both 'not found' and 'not yours', to avoid leaking existence; allowed if (CLIENT && expense.clientId===session.user.clientProfileId) or (ACCOUNTANT && expense.client.accountantId===session.user.id). PATCH /api/expenses/[id] — CLIENT-only, only while status==='PENDING' && !locked (400 otherwise), re-validates any new categoryId against the client's accountant the same way POST does. POST /api/expenses/[id]/review — ACCOUNTANT-only, requires expense.client.accountantId===session.user.id (403 otherwise), body {decision:'APPROVED'|'REJECTED', note?}; REJECTED without a non-empty note returns 400; on success sets status, reviewNote (null if empty/omitted), reviewedById=session.user.id, reviewedAt=new Date(), and locked=true for BOTH APPROVED and REJECTED (design choice: locking both outcomes prevents any further client edits once an accountant has made any decision, matching 'accountant always reviews manually' intent — FEAT-004's receipt/OCR review flow should follow the same locked=true-on-either-decision rule). UI: /app/expenses (Server Component, same clientId-scoped Prisma query as the GET route, lists status badges + rejection reviewNote), /app/expenses/new (Client Component form posting to POST /api/expenses, category select drives pre-filled-but-editable deductible/btwRate), /admin/clients/[clientId]/expenses (Server Component, 404s via notFound() if clientId doesn't belong to the current accountant — checked before any expense query runs; renders a PENDING list with inline ReviewActions client component wired to POST .../review, plus a reviewed-history list) — this page/pattern is where FEAT-004 should add the receipt-image-beside-data panel and confidence flags, reusing ReviewActions as-is. Verified (user-run, this agent's own bash tool hit the environment's 130/^C blocker on lint/tsc/build so results were relayed back by the user): `npm run lint` 0 errors; `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm run build` succeeded, listing /admin/clients/[clientId]/expenses, /api/expenses, /api/expenses/[id], /api/expenses/[id]/review, /app/expenses, /app/expenses/new among routes (plus all FEAT-002 routes), 'ƒ Proxy (Middleware)' still present; scripts/verify-isolation.ts (left in place, documented here per context.json's guidance) printed 4/4 PASS covering client-vs-client isolation (Cases 1/1b) AND accountant-vs-accountant isolation (Case 2: cross-tenant ?clientId access rejected 403; Case 3: own-tenant access returns only that tenant's rows) — broader than the task's literal ask but exercises the same WHERE-clause-level rule at both hierarchy levels; curl smoke test of GET /api/expenses without a session cookie returned 401 {"error":"No autorizado"}; `npm run start` server was stopped afterward with nothing left running.
